name: Bondtech LGX Lite
description: The Bondtech LGX Lite is a lighter, more compact version of the LGX extruder designed specifically for direct drive applications where minimizing toolhead mass is important. It uses a two-stage 44:10, 37:17 gear reduction with large dual drive gears and is redesigned to mount a NEMA14 motor, reducing overall weight significantly.

motorSpecs.compatibleMotors: NEMA14 36mm round stepper with 10T motor gear

features: Lighter than standard LGX for reduced toolhead inertia
Large dual drive gears for high filament grip
Optimized for high-speed direct drive printers
